stage_0_falsification_experiment.ceo_directive: Start with the smallest experiment capable of killing the hypothesis: Can any candidate signal precede fragmentation by >=1-2 seconds? Use the minimum multimodal instrumentation necessary to answer that. Only after a reproducible precursor exists should the team test prediction, then velocity modulation, then embolization reduction.
stage_0_falsification_experiment.design_principle: FALSIFICATION-FIRST. The experiment is designed to KILL the hypothesis, not to confirm it. If no reproducible pre-fragmentation signal exists with >=1s lead time, the candidate dies immediately and Slot 5 returns to EMPTY.
stage_0_falsification_experiment.the_single_question: Does any measurable signal reliably precede optically-confirmed clot fragmentation by >=1 second, across at least 2 clot compositions, in at least 2 independent trials per composition?
stage_0_falsification_experiment.if_no_kill: If the answer is NO, the candidate is KILLED immediately. Record CE-019. Slot 5 EMPTY. No further software analysis. Pivot axes (1-5) from Round 58 revisited.
stage_0_falsification_experiment.if_yes_survive: If the answer is YES (signal exists with >=1s lead time, reproducible across compositions and trials), advance to Stage 1 (out-of-sample prediction validation). Do NOT advance directly to intervention testing.

samples.material: Fresh porcine blood thrombus formed ex vivo within 24h of experiment
samples.compositions: 2 compositions minimum: (1) RBC-rich (static stasis clot), (2) fibrin-rich (Chandler loop flow-formed). If only 1 composition is available, start with fibrin-rich (most likely to fragment under traction).
samples.n_per_composition: Minimum 5 clots per composition (10 total). If resource-constrained, minimum 3 per composition (6 total).
samples.negative_control: 2 gelatin/agar phantoms (known non-fragmenting) to verify sensing chain does not produce false-positive fracture signatures

instrumentation.primary_sensor: Proximal axial force transducer (load cell, >=100Hz sampling) at the traction actuator
instrumentation.secondary_sensor: Proximal displacement encoder (>=100Hz) to compute force-displacement trajectory
instrumentation.ground_truth: High-speed optical camera (>=500fps) through transparent vessel mockup, recording continuously. Fragmentation onset = first visible particle separation from main clot body.
instrumentation.aspiration_pressure: Pressure transducer in aspiration line (for confound recording, not primary analysis)
NOT_included_in_stage_0: Impedance spectroscopy (defer to Stage 1 if force signal is promising)
Neural network prediction models (defer to Stage 1)

conditions.vessel: Straight transparent tube (ID 4-6mm, representative of M1 MCA). NO curvature in Stage 0 (curvature is a Stage 1 robustness test).
conditions.flow: Static (no flow) OR low steady flow (10-20 mL/min). NO pulsatile flow in Stage 0 (pulsatility is a Stage 1 robustness test).
conditions.traction: Constant-velocity pull at 2 mm/s (standard experimental rate per literature). Single velocity — NO velocity sweep in Stage 0 (velocity sweep is Stage 1).
conditions.aspiration: Fixed vacuum at -20 inHg (standard clinical aspiration). Single pressure — NO pressure sweep in Stage 0.

protocol.step_1: Form clots per composition protocol. Measure and record clot mass, length, visual appearance (photo).
protocol.step_2: Mount clot in transparent vessel mockup. Engage retrieval device (stent retriever or aspiration catheter) per standard technique.
protocol.step_3: Start continuous recording: force (>=100Hz), displacement (>=100Hz), aspiration pressure (>=10Hz), optical video (>=500fps). Synchronize timestamps across all channels.
protocol.step_4: Initiate constant-velocity traction at 2 mm/s. Continue until clot is fully removed OR fragmentation occurs OR 60 seconds elapsed.
protocol.step_5: Stop recording. Label trial with: clot ID, composition, outcome (complete removal / fragmentation / no engagement).
protocol.step_6: Repeat for all clots. Interleave compositions (do not batch all RBC-rich then all fibrin-rich).
protocol.step_7: Optical video review: for each trial with fragmentation, determine the exact frame of first visible particle separation. Record as t_fragmentation.
protocol.step_8: Feature extraction (BLINDED): an analyst who does NOT know the fragmentation timing extracts candidate features from the force and displacement signals. Features to test: (a) force magnitude, (b) force derivative (dF/dt), (c) force high-frequency content (>10Hz), (d) force-displacement slope (stiffness), (e) displacement irregularity. For each feature, compute the time series and identify any deviation from baseline.
protocol.step_9: Unblinding: compare feature deviation times to t_fragmentation. Compute lead time = t_fragmentation - t_feature_deviation.
protocol.step_10: Report: for each clot with fragmentation, what is the earliest feature deviation and its lead time? Across all fragmenting clots, what is the median lead time?

blinding_protocol.feature_selection_blinded: The analyst extracting force/displacement features does NOT have access to the optical video or fragmentation timing. They see only the force and displacement time series.
blinding_protocol.ground_truth_scoring: The analyst scoring fragmentation onset from optical video does NOT have access to the force/displacement data. They see only the video.
blinding_protocol.unblinding: A third party merges the two datasets by timestamp and computes lead times.

kill_conditions_stage_0.K0_1_no_fragmentation: If <3 clots fragment across all trials, the experiment is inconclusive (not enough fragmentation events to test the hypothesis). Re-design with more friable clot compositions or more aggressive traction.
kill_conditions_stage_0.K0_2_no_signal: If NO force/displacement feature shows any deviation preceding fragmentation in ANY trial, the pre-fragmentation signal does not exist. KILL. Record CE-019.
kill_conditions_stage_0.K0_3_lead_time_too_short: If features deviate before fragmentation but median lead time <1 second, the signal exists but is too early to act on. KILL. Record CE-019.
kill_conditions_stage_0.K0_4_not_reproducible: If a feature deviates before fragmentation in some trials but not others (with no systematic pattern), the signal is not reproducible. KILL. Record CE-019.
kill_conditions_stage_0.K0_5_confounded_by_motion: If feature deviations are equally present in negative-control (gelatin) trials where no fragmentation occurs, the signal reflects device motion, not clot state. KILL. Record CE-019.

success_criteria_stage_0.minimum_for_survival: At least ONE force or displacement feature deviates from baseline >=1 second before optically-confirmed fragmentation, in >=60% of fragmenting trials, across BOTH clot compositions, with NO deviation in negative-control trials.
success_criteria_stage_0.if_met: Advance to Stage 1 (out-of-sample prediction with held-out clots, impedance spectroscopy, robustness across flow/curvature/velocity).
success_criteria_stage_0.if_not_met: KILL the candidate. Record CE-019 (pre-fragmentation signal does not exist or is not actionable). Slot 5 returns to EMPTY.

minimum_experiment_design.estimated_cost: Minimal: 6-10 fresh clots, 1 load cell, 1 displacement encoder, 1 pressure transducer, 1 high-speed camera, 1 transparent tube. Total equipment cost if not already available: ~$5,000-$10,000. Consumables: ~$200-$500. Time: 1-2 days of experimental work + 1-2 days of analysis. No clinical collaborator required for Stage 0 (ex vivo only). No IRB required (no human or animal subjects).
what_stage_0_does_NOT_test: Patentability (§103 remains OPEN regardless of Stage 0 outcome)

three_separated_claims.claim_1_signal_existence: A measurable physical signal (force, displacement, or derivative feature) deviates from baseline >=1 second before optically-confirmed clot fragmentation. This is the Stage 0 question. If FALSE, the candidate dies.
three_separated_claims.claim_2_prediction_validity: The signal can be used to predict fragmentation out-of-sample (on held-out clots not used for feature selection) with clinically acceptable sensitivity and specificity. This is the Stage 1 question. If FALSE, the candidate dies (signal exists but is not predictive).
three_separated_claims.claim_3_intervention_effectiveness: Acting on the prediction (modulating traction velocity) reduces distal embolization compared to non-predictive control. This is the Stage 2 question. If FALSE, the candidate dies (prediction works but intervention does not help).
three_separated_claims.separation_principle: These three claims must be tested sequentially and independently. Do NOT collapse them. A positive Stage 0 does NOT justify claiming prediction validity. A positive Stage 1 does NOT justify claiming intervention effectiveness. Each claim must survive its own falsification test.
